issue.title: F16 · A print can't get stuck
issue.body:
**PRD ID:** F16
### Summary
Prints get stuck at the outer edge of a screen and on the shared edge between joined screens.
### Acceptance (Given / When / Then)
Outer edge: a drag ended by `pointercancel` or lost pointer capture puts the print back where it started. A print always keeps 40 px on screen. Shared edge: a print belongs to the screen its centre is on and snaps fully onto it, with a small buffer so it doesn't flick back. If the other screen can't take it, it snaps back. Edge: "Tidy up" brings every print back into view.
